description: This file defines the AdaptableBuilder interface, which specifies methods for building Adaptable instances by setting payload and headers, and then creating the Adaptable object.

classes.name: AdaptableBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building Adaptable objects with methods to set payload and headers, and to construct the object.

methods.name: withPayload
methods.description: Sets the payload for the builder, replacing any previous payload, and returns the builder for chaining.

methods.name: withHeaders
methods.description: Sets headers for the builder, replacing any previous headers, and returns the builder for chaining.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates and returns an Adaptable instance with the previously set payload and headers.
